name: Sparse Voxel Octree Rendering via Square Splats
definition: A rendering technique that visualizes sparse voxel octrees (SVOs) by converting leaf voxels into square splats (billboards) using a geometry shader, assembled in a programmable graphics pipeline (OpenGL).
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Rendering via Square Splats visualizes sparse voxel octrees by converting leaf voxels into view-aligned square splats, enabling efficient rasterization with precise face culling.
